name: Set Vault Metadata
description: Set the application metadata of a file or directory in the user's personal vault, or clear it with null. The value is kept with the entry: a move or rename takes it along, replacing the file's content in place keeps it, and deleting the entry removes it. The entry's content and modified time are unchanged.
creator: Covia

path.description: Path of an existing file or directory in the vault

metadata.description: The value to keep with the entry, replacing any it had. Use structured values (objects/arrays/scalars). Null clears it.
The metadata the entry now has, null for none
